# `candid dashboard`

Launch the local web dashboard (127.0.0.1 only).

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid dashboard [-h] [--port PORT] [--no-browser]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--port` `PORT` | Preferred port (tries the next 10 if busy) (default: 8765) |
| `--no-browser` | Don't auto-open the browser |
